back_translation: For behold, the Sovereign Master, the LORD of Hosts, is about to take away every prop and every support from Jerusalem and Judah: every reliance on food and every reliance on water,
namely the hero and the warrior, the judge and the prophet, the diviner and the elder,
the officer commanding a unit of fifty and the honored man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the expert in casting spells.
"I will make youths their masters, and capricious brats will rule over them."
The people will oppress one another, man against man, neighbor against neighbor; the child will be insolent toward the adult, and the base person insolent toward the honorable.
A man will grab his brother in his father's house, saying, "You still have a cloak — come and be our leader! This heap of ruins will be under your hand."
In that day he will cry out in reply, "I will not be a wound-dresser; in my house there is neither food nor clothing. Do not appoint me leader of the people!"
For Jerusalem has stumbled, and Judah has fallen, because their speech and their deeds are against the LORD, an affront to the glorious eyes of His glory.
The look on their faces is a witness accusing them; they display their sin openly like Sodom; they do not hide it at all. Woe to their souls, for they have brought disaster upon themselves.
Tell the righteous that it will be well with them, for they will eat the fruit of their own deeds.
Woe to the wicked — disaster will fall upon him, for what his hands have done will be repaid to him.
As for My people — children oppress them, and women rule over them. O My people, your guides lead you astray and have confused the paths you should walk.
The LORD rises up to contend in court; He stands up to judge the peoples.
The LORD enters into judgment with the elders and the princes of His people: "It is you who have devoured the vineyard completely; the plunder taken from the poor is in your houses.
What right do you have to crush My people and to mill-grind the faces of the poor?" — thus the LORD of Hosts has declared.
The LORD says: "Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, walking with necks held high, casting mocking glances, stepping with mincing gait, with anklets jingling at every step,
the Sovereign Master will make scabs break out on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the LORD will make their foreheads bald and bare."
In that day the Sovereign Master will take away all their finery: the anklets, the headbands, and the crescent ornaments;
the dangling earrings, the bracelets, and the face-veils;
the head-ornaments, the ankle chains, the waist-sashes, the perfume bottles, and the amulet charms;
the signet rings and the nose rings;
the festival garments, the long capes, the shoulder-shawls, and the money purses;
the mirrors, the linen garments, the head-turbans, and the thin veils.

And it will be like this: instead of fragrance there will be a rotten stench; instead of a waist-sash, a rope; instead of beautifully styled hair, a bald head; instead of a fine robe, sackcloth girded on the body; and instead of beauty, a burn-brand.
Your men will fall by the sword, and your warriors will fall in the war.
The gates of Zion will lament and mourn; and she, utterly destitute, will sit on the ground.
